caption:
How to keep a consistent tone of voice with AI: make a style card

When every post starts from a blank prompt, every post sounds a bit different. Fix it once:

"Here's something I wrote: [PASTE A POST OR EMAIL YOU LIKE]. Describe my writing style in 5 short bullets I can reuse: sentence length, words I use, tone, how I start and end."

I tried it with a post from an example bakery. The style card: short punchy sentences, chatty asides in brackets, everyday words, warm and a little cheeky, opens with news and ends with a nudge to visit.

Save those 5 bullets in your notes app and paste them at the top of every request. Posts, emails, replies: same voice.
